remarks: Welcome to this tranquil 5 bedroom haven on a quiet cul-de-sac, conveniently located near schools, trains, and highways. With two primary suites, this home caters to your every need. A dream worthy walk-in closet, and lavish ensuite bathroom define the first floor suite. The second floor suite boasts a tray ceiling and equal opulence. An entertainer's delight with sun filled living room, open concept kitchen with breakfast room, and deck overlooking a beautifully landscaped backyard. The lower level offers a 10+ft ceiling entertainment space, walk-out access to the yard, a kitchenette, and a full bathroom, perfect for hosting and relaxation. A thoughtfully designed office space on the lower level ensures a quiet and productive environment. Also available for sale.
